Tile and Grout Cleaning Cost- The Latest Update For 2022

June 15, 2022
Table of Contents

Tiles are one of the beautiful things you can add to your home. But it requires care and maintenance for you to keep their condition. You have two options in cleaning tiles: do it on your own, or hire a professional. But just how much does tile and grout cleaning cost?

Today, we’re going to talk about it here. We understand how challenging it is to clean your tiles, so hiring a cleaner is your best option. Know more about what’s the running price of tile cleaning services and the factors affecting it.

Tile and Grout Cleaning Cost

The average cost of tile and grout cleaningis $465, yet most homeowners spend around $282 to $654 for hiring a professional tile cleaner. The overall cost depends on the total tile area and how difficult it is to be cleaned.

If we go on a per square foot rate, the price is around $0.50 to $3. If you have a 100 square feet tiled area, then the expected cost is $50 to $300. Tile cleaning isn’t that cheap since it requires a lot of skill. But you’ll definitely love the works of a professional in bringing back the cleanliness and beauty of your tiles and grouts.

How much does tile cleaning cost per square foot?

The average tile and grout cleaning cost per square footis $0.50 to $3 whereas the minimum cost paid by customers is between $100 to $200. Among the different factors affecting price, it’s the total square footage that matters most.

Some cleaning companies charge a flat fee for their tile cleaning service. For instance, they charge $300 to $500 for cleaning a 150 to 250 square foot tile floor.

Others charge on hourly basis. The average hourly rate of most cleaning companies is between $30 to $50 per hour for one cleaner.

If you want to make sure you’re paying the right amount, you can get a free quote from different cleaners. You can also request one from us online on our website.

How much is tile cleaning cost per room?

The running rate for professional tile cleaning per room is $300 to $600. Oftentimes, this includes grout sealing after cleaning your tiles and grouts. By resealing the grout, you are preventing dirt and bacteria from growing in between and underneath your tiles.

A professional cleaning company knows the best practices for tile and grout cleaning. We also know how to reseal your grouts so that it looks cleaner and more resistant again to water and dirt.

Professionals can also give different rates for cleaning the tiles of the different rooms of your house. Below are some price estimates:

  • Small kitchen (75 sq.ft.) – $75 to $230
  • Bathroom (100 sq.ft.) – $100 to $300
  • Master bathroom (150 sq.ft.) – $150 to $500
  • Standard kitchen (300 sq.ft.) – $300 to $900

What factors affect the price of a tile and cleaning service?

A few things are affecting the price of tile cleaning services. The three main variables are square footage, type of cleaning method, and hours it would take to complete the job.

Square footage

The larger the square footage, the higher will be the price you’ll be paying. This is standard since it takes more time and effort to clean a wider tiled area.

Tile cleaning method

So far, different cleaning companies have their way of cleaning tiles. The common methods are handwashing, pressurized cleaning, and steam tile cleaning. Typically, the more intricate the tile cleaning process, the higher its cost, especially if it’s done manually with bare hands.

Also, the kind of tile matters in how you’ll clean them. Tiles made of natural or synthetic stone are more delicate to clean. Porcelain and ceramic tiles are the easiest to clean and maintain. The more resilient tiles are vinyl, linoleum, and cork tiles.

Cost per tile cleaning method

  • Steam cleaning or pressure washing can cost around $0.75 to $3 per square foot.
  • Spot cleaning for tiles is around $30 to $40 per hour.

Hiring a professional can cost more but for the sake of preserving your tiles, that’s a good return on your investment knowing that tiles are expensive. A professional cleaning company can give you the best price for your tile cleaning. You just have to reach out and book a free consultation.

Tile cleaning requirements

If your tiles have hard sticky stains and require resealing, then expect to pay higher. That’s because it takes more effort and time to remove those stains and for resealing the grout.

Tiles and grout cleaning services costincrease when it takes more time to wash and restore the cleanliness of your tiled surface. Oftentimes, a professional will evaluate your tile condition before giving a quote.

When is the right time to clean your tiles?

The condition of your tiles is often overlooked since you handle many things at home and work. But that shouldn’t be the case since tiles take so much footprint and you can easily notice if they look dingy and old.

So, what are the signs that you need to clean your tiles?

  • If you see some discolorations, that’s a strong sign that you need to clean them.
  • If there are yellow, green, or black stains on your tiles and grouts. That indicates you need to call a professional cleaning service.
  • If your grout needs resealing. This is a must to prevent the growth of bacteria in between your tiles.
